mapper.select: SELECT id FROM app_shop WHERE code = #{code} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM app_staff WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM app_member WHERE mobile = #{mobile} AND name = #{name} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_member (shop_id, name, mobile, owner_staff_id, source_system, status, first_seen) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{name}, #{mobile}, #{ownerStaffId}, 'santi', 'ACTIVE', #{firstSeen})
mapper.select: SELECT id, mobile AS mobile, countcard_lessons AS countcardLessons, timecard_expire AS timecardExpire, teacher_name AS teacherName, review_status AS reviewStatus, review_reason AS reviewReason, dispatched_at AS dispatchedAt FROM followup_snapshot WHERE mobile = #{mobile} AND snapshot_date < #{date} ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO followup_snapshot (shop_id, snapshot_date, import_batch, member_id, staff_id, member_name, mobile, teacher_name, tier, activity, last_class_date, days_since_class, attend_count, timecard_expire, timecard_days_left, countcard_lessons, countcard_days_left, last_sign_date, last_product, last_sign_amount, talk_script, total_paid, sign_count, bought_199, timecard_kind, countcard_kind, extra_json, queue, sort_key, review_status, review_reason, dispatched_at) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{snapshotDate}, #{importBatch}, #{memberId}, #{staffId}, #{memberName}, #{mobile}, #{teacherName}, #{tier}, #{activity}, #{lastClassDate}, #{daysSinceClass}, #{attendCount}, #{timecardExpire}, #{timecardDaysLeft}, #{countcardLessons}, #{countcardDaysLeft}, #{lastSignDate}, #{lastProduct}, #{lastSignAmount}, #{talkScript}, #{totalPaid}, #{signCount}, #{bought199}, #{timecardKind}, #{countcardKind}, #{extraJson}, #{queue}, #{sortKey}, #{reviewStatus}, #{reviewReason}, #{dispatchedAt})
INSERT IGNORE INTO followup_flag (snapshot_id, reason_code) VALUES (#{snapshotId}, #{reasonCode})
